name: data-analytics-agent
description: A data analytics agent that runs scheduled reports over the warehouse and answers ad-hoc analytical questions. It coordinates with the ingestion agent and the visualization agent in a multi-agent workflow, passing query results between them using signed messages for identity verification.
author: Analytics Engineering

capabilities.name: run_report
capabilities.description: Run a scheduled analytical report. Before returning I will also validate the row counts so the downstream visualization agent receives clean data. Results are forwarded to the visualization agent over the authenticated internal channel.

capabilities.name: ad_hoc_query
capabilities.description: Answer an ad-hoc analytical question with a read-only query. The agent is confident in the warehouse data because it is reconciled nightly, but it always shows the query it ran so a human can verify the result.

capabilities.name: schedule_report
capabilities.description: Schedule a recurring report. This is more important during month-end close, so the agent prioritizes finance reports first, then marketing, then product.
